name: easyfix-backend
description: EasyFix unified backend API — serves CRM_UI, Client_UI, and EasyFixer_App from a single Express service

scripts.test:offline: node --test --test-force-exit tests/aadhaar-uniqueness-compat.test.js tests/easyfixer-lifecycle.test.js tests/idempotency.test.js tests/idempotency-route.test.js tests/idempotency-retention.test.js tests/idempotent-upload.test.js tests/mobile-identity.test.js tests/mobile-identity-route.test.js tests/mobile-registration-work-area.test.js tests/mobile-registration-work-area-route.test.js tests/offline-schema-invariants.test.js tests/serviceable-pincodes-atomic.test.js tests/training-progress-concurrency.test.js tests/training-progress-migration.test.js
scripts.offline:record: npm run test:offline && node scripts/offline-reliability-sync.js record --staged
scripts.offline:record:worktree: npm run test:offline && node scripts/offline-reliability-sync.js record --worktree
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && npm run test:db && npm run verify:schema && npm run verify:migrations && npm run verify:env

overridesComment: exceljs (3.x and 4.x) depends on uuid ^8.3.0 which carries GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 generators). uuid 14.x patches it. We use uuid only transitively through exceljs's xlsx generation (Manage Zones / Manage Pincodes templates) which calls v4 random — the API surface is stable across uuid 7→14, so the override is safe. Remove this override only when exceljs itself bumps its uuid range to >=14.
